title: Published catalog
description: stories/<channel>/catalog.json on the content host (draft or production): the shelf the app downloads at every launch, written by `story package` from content/catalog.json and the stories. The app ignores fields it doesn't know. See docs/story-format.md, "Published stories".

file.description: A file in stories/<id>/, named after its contents.

title.description: The title in every language the story is published in.

languages.description: Every language a reader can download, the story's first language first.

bytes.description: The download in this language alone: the pictures, the text and the narration.

cover.description: The cover picture, shown on the shelf before the story is downloaded. Missing while it isn't delivered (dev only).

manifest.description: The story's current manifest (schema/manifest.schema.json). A new name means the story changed.
